messages.subject: frequency modulation in animal sound
parts:
Dear all, 
I am trying to find a function that would enable me to get a measure for frequency modulations in the animal calls I am analyzing.
I would like to be able to extract some values similair to the ones used by the fm option of the function synth.

fm is a vector of length 3 including:
(1) the maximum excursion of a sinusoidal frequency modulation (in Hz),
(2) the frequency of a sinusoidal frequency modulation,
(3) the maximum excursion of a linear frequency modulation (in Hz).

Would this be possible. I have been playing around with for instance ifreq, but I am not able to figure it out. 
Thanks a lot in advance for your help.

Greetings David Jansen

messages.author: de80047cbc18c87e
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] frequency modulation in animal sound
parts:
Dear David,

I am not an expert in FM analysis but as far as I know there is unfortunately no tool to modelize the FM.

You can try to track the dominant, the fundamental, or the instantaneous frequency with the dfreq(), fund() and ifreq() functions respectively.

This will return a time series that you can try to describe and modelize with time series statistical tools.

Any other suggestion from other users would be welcome,

Jerome
